title: Side of the stage
description: Free band of osu!mania's layout the counter floats in, held 48 px from that screen edge and centred in the band's height. right keeps it clear of a stage centred by the skin or by lazer; left suits skins that push the stage right.

title: Horizontal nudge / px
description: Moves the counter right (positive) or left (negative) from its place in the band.

title: Vertical nudge / px
description: Moves the counter down (positive) or up (negative).

title: Scale
description: Size multiplier, 0.5–2. The counter is 240 px wide at 1.

title: Backing
description: none floats on the game with a light text shadow; scrim adds a soft dark fade behind the numbers; panel draws a graphite panel.

title: Accent colour
description: map tints the 18—LAB tag, live dot and leading rule with the current map's tonal colour; 18-lab keeps amber. Judgement colours never change.

title: Show MAX:300 ratio
description: MAX (320) judgements per 300, to two decimals; ∞ until the first 300. Also shown on the results screen, which osu! does not.

title: Show keys per second
description: Presses in the last second and the attempt's peak, counted from vosu's keys.all. The results screen keeps the peak of the attempt you just played.
